guidanceConsulted.query: responsive tables horizontal scroll accessibility reference documentation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Place all content within semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), use sequential headings, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, and focusable keyboard-accessible regions without overusing labeled <section> landmarks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer>, sequential h1/h2/h3, captioned tables with <th scope>, and focusable .table-wrap scroll regions linked via aria-labelledby.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing (max-inline-size), horizontal scroll containers with overflow: auto rather than overflow: hidden clipping, and flex-wrap with gap for wrapping browser badge lists.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100% and shared overflow-x scrolling for .compat-table and .scroll-table; .baseline-browsers inherits flex-wrap from /public/styles.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Apply text-wrap: balance specifically to short headings (h1-h3) rather than globally, and keep long code blocks and prose legible on narrow screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied via shared /public/styles.css without overriding h1, pre, or code inline; body copy avoids global text-wrap: balance.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Rely on root color-scheme and semantic light-dark() design tokens for consistent light and dark themes rather than hard-coded colors.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: inherits color-scheme and semantic CSS variables exclusively from /public/styles.css, with zero hard-coded colors in inline CSS.
